## Ad Clone Workflow: From Winner to Creative Matrix [...] DTC brands running paid acquisition at scale face a specific version of the creative fatigue problem: product catalog breadth. A brand with 50 SKUs cannot produce net-new creative for every product on every platform. Ad cloning applied at the product level — using a single high-performing template and swapping product assets — is how mature ecommerce operators maintain coverage without proportional creative spend.

The Ecommerce Ad Creator from AdGPT is built for exactly this workflow. Drop in a product URL, define the offer, and the system generates multiple creative variants based on the structural logic of proven formats. For agencies managing multiple DTC clients, this collapses the per-client creative production burden significantly.

### 4. Move at the Speed Your Market Requires

Ad trends on TikTok and Meta move fast. A format that is dominating today may be saturated in six weeks. Brands that can identify a working format and launch their own version quickly capture the performance window. Brands still waiting on production when the format peaks miss it entirely.

Ad Clone compresses the time between "I see what's working" and "I have my version live" from weeks to minutes.

### 5. Level the Playing Field

The production bottleneck has historically been a structural advantage for large brands with big creative teams and agency relationships. They could test at scale. Everyone else could not. [...] Ad Clone is the systematized, automated version of what good marketers were already doing intuitively. The insight is not new. What is new is the ability to execute it in 10 minutes.

## How Ad Clone Works - Step by Step

### Step 1 - Provide a Reference Ad Link

The first step is identifying an ad whose structure you want to apply to your product. This does not have to be a competitor's ad. It simply needs to be a format that performs well in your category or for your target audience.
